correctness.rationale: On H=P2 square P3 square P3, the exact coordinate fiber lift pi(v)=(v0,v1+v2,v3+v4) is surjective, injective as a map of state configurations, and intertwines the GH 0/1/2 update for every Q_d, d>=5. Extra-coordinate edges join same-fiber states so cannot excite resting vertices; each coordinate change has a quotient neighbor. The complete 7-word and 14-word traces were fetched and independently checked by a new direct JavaScript 18-vertex update: respectively all 7 and 14 transitions close with unique intermediate words. Thus exact least periods persist for all d>=5. The lower-dimensional exclusions are finite: source check_witnesses.py enumerates 3^(2^d) for d=1,2,3; both independent dimension-four C source algorithms (DFS functional digraph and indegree peeling) were read and their complete deterministic 43,046,721-state outputs match byte-for-byte with periods only 1,3,4,10. Completeness is justified by exhaustive loops, not extrapolated finite sampling.
